# Composition fixtures and frozen vectors

Literal standalone schema/default/closure inputs, not accepted source projects.
Positive cases validate complete catalogues; negative cases have stable boundary
codes. Boundary cases declare exact and one-over policies; migration retains the
old schema without adding new members. Runtime copies belong to vocabulary tests.
The `requests.json` files register 26 complete literal input cases with exact
source/bundle byte digests, transitive locks, source diagnostic outcomes,
and catalogue exact/one-over controls. These are review fixture envelopes, not
serialized public API requests. `vectors.json` contains a resolved /2 project,
five complete identity transcripts/digests, twelve logical variations and eight
rejection vectors. Runtime-owned copies and the independent oracle belong to
`neutral-test-suite/tests/composition_contract`.

The manifest distinguishes the required standalone `composition-catalogue` suite
from the required complete `composition-contract` suite. The explicit successor
compiler/codec/reader/probe/identity boundaries compare these unchanged inputs;
the frozen contract text records the pre-implementation checkpoint, while the
manifest/review/freeze records current activation. Verify pins before promotion;
do not regenerate expectations to bless changed behavior. Old schema/profile
vectors remain unchanged; authoring and implicit CLI selection are not activated.
